blocks.html: Workflow Automation is the use of technology and software tools to automate repetitive tasks, approvals, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and operational consistency.
Workflow automation helps businesses reduce manual work and streamline day-to-day operations. It can be applied across departments such as sales, marketing, HR, finance, and customer support.

items.html: Data entry and syncing between systems

blocks.html: Automation allows teams to focus on higher-value work instead of repetitive tasks.
When a lead fills out a website form, the CRM automatically creates a record, assigns it to a rep, and schedules a follow-up task.
Workflow Automation uses technology to streamline repetitive processes and improve business efficiency.
Work smarter with automation. MarketJoy helps businesses implement workflow automation that boosts productivity and growth.
